summary: service_facts collects service state as facts; access ansible_facts.services with bracket notation because names can contain dashes.
questions: How do I check whether a service exists on a host?
How do I list all services and their states?

answer_card.title: Gather service state with service_facts
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.service_facts` populates `ansible_facts.services`. Use **bracket notation**, e.g. `ansible_facts.services['zuul-gateway']`, since dashes break dot notation. AIX SRC supported since 2.11.
